tagline: Role based access control (RBAC) will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled in mid September 2026.
what_it_does: Role based access control (RBAC) will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled in mid September 2026. RBAC lets users assume a role in Databricks. When a user assumes a role, only that role's permissions apply, rather than the user's accumulated permissions.
